reports.summary:
F-settings fixed every offscreen item on its work list, at the root cause, with renders, Figma comparisons and 9 new pixel and behaviour tests. Each test, except the label-anchor function test, fails when its fix is reverted (an isolated copy gave 11 failures; see neg-tests.log).

- **P1 Light dialog buttons:** DialogButton's secondary tile is now scheme-aware. Dark keeps Figma's BG/A3 (6216:13750, 1994:5586); Light uses BG/A4. This covers every DialogShell dialog plus the Cancel buttons in Keyboard Shortcuts.
- **MAJOR S25/S37/S48 scrim:** The dialog host's layer still catches clicks but draws nothing. This follows the video (06m02.47, 17m40.9) and spec-part1 §06; D035 is amended.
- **Compact windows:** A shrunk dialog keeps the 40 pt top bar clear at both edges. It stays centred and no longer runs under the traffic lights.
- **Toggles:** They use Figma 536:1013's 3 pt inset and 3 pt gap. The toggle region is gone from all 14 Settings checks; all remain REVIEW.
- **S54 slider labels:** Each label stands under its tick (Figma 3062:13083 and 3176:16483).
- **S56 Replay gain preamp:** It reads '0.0'. The fix is a one-line mock edit plus step 0.1 in the catalog.
- **S59 caching fields:** The disabled fields draw their value in the placeholder colour, so they read as empty like Figma. A D050 line records this.
- **Narrow Settings:** 'Always starts at:' stays on one line; the 'Startup volume' label wraps instead.
- **S64 disabled Save:** The fill now uses the W3C Luminosity compositing Figma uses. It reads #1F1E1D, and the check went from FAIL to REVIEW.
- **S65 Media Info:** The dialog height fits its content, so all six track rows show.
- **S27 Choose Files:** The tile uses Figma's Cancel style (BG/A3), not BG/A5.
- **PER-02:** The symlink check (resolvingSymlinksInPath) that Add Subtitles Save ran on the MainActor now runs on the lookup queue. Save is async and blocks a second click while it runs.

All related suites pass. The swift build has no warnings in my files.

verdict.summary:
I checked F-settings independently (round 1). No blocker or major remains. Every item on the work list is fixed at its root cause, and I looked at fresh renders of each one next to Figma or the key frames.

**Build and tests**
- swift build is clean.
- These suites pass on the shared tree: SettingsDialogsPolishTests 9/9, DialogsTests, SubtitleReopenRegressionTests, WindowShippingParityTests, DialogScrollEdgeTests, SettingsUITests, SettingsWorkflowTests, SettingsCatalogLintTests, and the DialogIsolation, ModalIsolation and DialogKeyLoop suites.
- The engine is untouched: the diff of src, lib, include and modules/gui/macosx against upstream-base-2026-10-14 is empty.

**Negative tests (my own isolated copy, F-settings-verify-r1/pkg, log in neg-tests.log)**
- Reverting the Light secondary fill and the scrim fails testSecondaryDialogButtonsStandOutFromTheLightDialogSurface and testDialogHostLeavesTheWindowBehindAtFullBrightness (3 points).
- Reverting only the top-bar margin in MXRDialogFrame.available fails testShrunkDialogStaysBelowTheTopBar: the dialog top is at 20, not 39 or more. So that test catches its own fix, not just the scrim.
- The fixer's log covers the other tests.

**Renders I looked at (F-settings-verify-r1/r2)**
- **P1 Light buttons:** In Light Convert, Choose… and Cancel now show a visible BG/A4 tile (#B3 on #D5). Stream, Disc, Media Info and Add Subtitles get the same.
- **S25 scrim:** Compared with key frame 06m02.5, the before render had the bars dimmed nearly black. The after render keeps the top bar and the control bar lit, and a pixel check confirms no dimming.
- **S48 Light over the player:** the bars are now light grey.
- **Compact windows:** Settings and Convert at 960×540 run from y 40 to 500, centred, with the header clear of the traffic lights.
- **S65 Media Info:** fitted height, all 6 track rows visible, Close at the bottom.
- **S54 speed labels:** match Figma 3062:13083 within about 1.5 pt.
- **S59 caching fields:** read as empty like 6543:15649.
- **Narrow Settings:** 'Always starts at:' stays on one line.
- **S27 Choose Files:** the tile is #1B on the #0E surface (Figma's Cancel style).

**Checks against Figma**
- S64 default: REVIEW. The only region left is key-cap text; the Save fill no longer appears.
- S48 general, playback, audio, network and controls: REVIEW, and the toggle region is gone.
- S25 folder, S36 and S27 results: REVIEW.

**Gate and code**
- SettingsFigmaDeviations is unchanged and the fixer added no deviations, so the gate was not loosened. The gallery-note edits only fix wording.
- New values are tokens or SettingsMetrics constants.

**PER-02**
- The last main-actor file-system call (the symlink identity check in Save) now runs on the shared lookup queue, and the result is dropped if the player has moved on.
- The other subtitle lookups (folder targets, rule application) were already on that queue.

**Decisions**
- D035 is well supported for the scrim: the video at 06m02.47 shows identical pixels with the dialog open, spec-part1 §06 says there is no visible scrim, and BG/B2 Transparent has a usage count of 0. Its Light wording is a little generous (see the issue below).
- D045 (Light secondary buttons on BG/A4): Figma has no Light dialog frame, and BG/A3 equals the Light surface, so a darker step on the same ramp is the smallest choice that keeps the tile visible. Owner sign-off pending.
- D050 (disabled caching fields): it now visually matches Figma's empty fields.

issues.description: The amendment says frames 17m40.9 and 17m44.0 keep the top bar 'at its normal value' in both themes. In the Light key frame (17m44.0) the top bar and control bar read mid-grey (about #8x), not the Light bar colour, so the Light half of that evidence is weak. The Dark evidence at 06m02.47 is solid. The owner should confirm the Light case when signing off D035.

Keeping 'Always starts at:' on one line at 480 pt now makes the 'Startup volume' row label wrap onto two lines, and the stacked control extends past the half-width column. It reads fine, but it is a trade-off rather than a match: no Figma narrow frame exists.

'0.5' and '1.75' are still about 1.5 pt off Figma. The REVIEW region at 742,242 says it matches if moved +1.5 pt. Figma lays these labels out as 26 pt boxes spread space-between, not exactly centred on the ticks. This is cosmetic, but a decision line or space-between anchoring would close it.

This test checks the anchor function, not drawn pixels, and the fixer says it does not fail when the fix is reverted (the old layout did not use the function). It documents the geometry but does not guard the drawn layout.

A clean build of the test target warns 'call to main actor-isolated static method location(of:) in a synchronous nonisolated context'. This is test-only and predates this wave, but it is not Swift 6 clean. The product build has no warnings in F-settings files.
